description:
Our product aims to utilize personalization to help astronauts optimize performance, prevent disease, and enable people with health conditions to participate in space missions.

We welcome members with backgrounds in computing, data, SW, design, healthcare, medical and life sciences, and spaceflight, including current, former, and aspiring astronauts.
summary:
Ophiuchus is a system that aims to answer the medical, and health needs to sustain long space travel.

Our prototype demonstrates several features that include state of the art algorithms, sensing hardware and scientific work. 

Using our system allows astronauts that are not experts to manage their health and handle medical events.
Furthermore, our insights and recommendation system delivers high-end information for the advanced user .

Further usage and development of the system is important for tackling the most critical aspects of sustaining longer presence in space.

Our unique approach collects information by crawlers and scrapers and implements our own Super-Intelligence, that is effectively representing the minds of many medical experts from all times together, with a single interface.

We identify sleep as a main challenge , due to its importance in maintaining health, and the criticality in space missions.  We collected data using several sensors during the night of the hackathon.  The data includes Heart rate, body temperature and EEG signals collected with an experimental EEG kit . We also include environmental data.

We also approached mental health, mood and social interaction as parts of our holistic system. 
We introduced 2 gamification methods for user engagement, and achievement of goals.
details:
We implemented our own Super-Inteligence model, which is a graph model generated by an Olama LLM NLP tasks defined by Promopts.
The code was generated using codex model.

We used an EEG data collection kit with a Texas Instrument components.

We used ppg technology to collect Heart rate by samsung android interface. Samsung watch 8.

We created "Ophi Tov" An SI model specialized to help in space medicine topics.
It has a face and a firendly interface with the user.

We used Base44 for mock-up testing.

And claude code with gemini agents for the final solution.
projectRefs: Why Do We Conduct Science Experiments in Space?
